evaluation.primary: Mean rank by player count and normalized rank score (players-rank)/(players-1); aggregate player counts equally

caveat: Fixed mode: 32 simulations per root candidate for everyone. Time mode: candidate 2000ms, opponents fixed rootCandidates × samples soft compute deadlines, finish a current rollout and cover all root actions; SH uses the published Anytime schedule. Candidate reward: relative; opponents: uct / relative reward. Parallel workers affect elapsed time and simulation counts; only the separately collected serial cost data are latency benchmarks. Seat rotations share seeds, so games are not independent trials.
